# Artifact Gateway v0.6.0

## 简体中文

本版本在 v0.5.0 基础上改进日志与诊断，新增默认关闭的邮件通知和仓库逻辑配额告警、Console 管理与可选 Compose 接线，并验证新状态恢复及固定 v0.5.0 升级回退。正式发行不代表生产部署或真实邮件投递验收完成。

**日志与诊断。** Console 支持当前进程的有界历史、增量跟随/暂停、复制和 NDJSON 导出，提供滚动最近范围与自定义时间筛选。脱敏诊断保留安全路由模板和 Raw Proxy 失败原因/阶段；当前进程业务 HTTP 5xx 观察显示真实采样边界，显式配置的本地挂载容量保留 unknown/stale 证据。离线 capacity/backup preflight 计算迁移容量并验证备份清单完整字节，不访问或修改目标，也不证明快照一致性。文件 NDJSON 与 OTLP/HTTP protobuf Logs 延续 v0.5.0 的显式启用和有界失败语义；查询仍仅覆盖当前进程内存，重启前历史、跨 session/集群聚合、持久重试及完整历史保留尚未完成。见 [运行日志](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.6.0/docs/runtime-logging.zh-CN.md)。

**邮件与逻辑配额。** 管理员可管理加密、只写收件人目标，预览沙箱中英 HTML/纯文本模板，并明确确认合成测试。目标和规则默认停用；保存和预览不发送。PostgreSQL 持久幂等、fencing、有限重试和验证 TLS 的 SMTP worker 提供交付证据。配额规则按仓库逻辑字节的持续阈值及恢复滞回评估，CAS 管理保留冲突门禁；陈旧或未知采样不能触发恢复。Console 展示状态、不可变事件和交付结果，可选 Compose overlay 接线 API/scheduler/email-worker。API ready 只证明本进程就绪，不能证明独立 sender 健康。SMTP 接受不等于收件箱送达；真实 SMTP、真实收件人、Gmail/Outlook/Apple Mail 和生产多角色部署仍待验收。本地挂载、5xx、S3/NAS 物理容量、Gateway/PG 自身失联等更多信号以及终态交付保留/清理尚未完成。见 [邮件部署契约](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.6.0/docs/email-notification-delivery.zh-CN.md)。

**恢复与升级。** 隔离 binary/OCI 备份恢复覆盖非空加密邮件目标、配额规则/状态/事件和 outbox，包括取消、并发租约及不确定交付结果。固定正式 v0.5.0 `ea60aea333b29bb60d4ac1b8e2b2a8720563726f` 的源构建演练验证迁移 `000136`–`000139`、重放 no-op、升级前快照回退及再前滚；不外推所有来源版本、协议、存储或生产环境。

升级前停止全部 writer、旧 evaluator 和 worker，保存一致的 PostgreSQL/对象快照，独立保管 settings 加密 key 与匹配配置；由单一迁移作业应用完整、校验和跟踪的 migration ledger，再启动同一 revision 的各角色及匹配 Console。回退先停止流量与新 worker，保留证据并核对外部邮件副作用，将升级前一致 DB/对象快照恢复到新的隔离目标，使用匹配 v0.5.0 软件、配置及独立 key。回退会丢失快照后变化；不得执行 down migration，也不能假定旧二进制能正确读取新数据库。固定正式二进制校验和和 OCI digest 后再做目标部署验收。见 [恢复手册](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.6.0/docs/recovery-runbook.zh-CN.md)。

**桌面 Console 与依赖。** 邮件/配额编辑器新增字段级校验与无效字段定位，邮件失败按读取、保存、预览的实际操作提示恢复；默认暗/亮主题主按钮各态文字对比度修正。本批人工 UI 验收限桌面，没有新增移动适配。移除可选 Ant Design CLI、`braces` 链及 10 月 17 日审计例外，保留 Ant Design 组件和现有生成、格式、覆盖率门禁。另一项 React Router RSC 审计例外仍按原策略至 2026-11-01 到期。

已验收冻结主线与发布准备提交的精确 CI 门禁分别记录；历史浏览器测试超时曾原样重跑通过，但根因仍未知，不宣称已修复。真实 Keycloak 登录是 opt-in fixture，未启用不计为验收。APT Hosted 仍为 operator preview。更广日志、恢复与通知验收继续开放，本发行不执行生产升级。

## English

This release improves logging and diagnostics, adds disabled-by-default email notifications and repository logical quota alerts with Console management and optional Compose wiring, and verifies new-state recovery plus a fixed v0.5.0 upgrade/rollback rehearsal. Formal distribution does not establish production deployment or real email delivery acceptance.

**Logs and diagnostics.** Console provides bounded current-process history, incremental follow/pause, copy and NDJSON export, rolling windows and custom time filters. Redacted diagnostic fields preserve safe route templates and Raw Proxy failure reasons/stages. Business HTTP 5xx observation reports actual sampling boundaries; explicitly configured local mount capacity preserves unknown/stale evidence. Offline capacity/backup preflight plans migration capacity and verifies complete manifest bytes without accessing or modifying a target or proving snapshot consistency. File NDJSON and OTLP/HTTP protobuf Logs retain v0.5.0's explicit opt-in and bounded failure semantics. Queries still cover current-process memory only; pre-restart history, cross-session/cluster aggregation, durable retry and complete historical retention remain incomplete. See [runtime logging](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.6.0/docs/runtime-logging.md).

**Email and logical quotas.** Administrators manage encrypted write-only recipient targets, preview sandboxed bilingual HTML/plain-text templates, and explicitly confirm synthetic tests. Targets and rules start disabled; saving and previewing do not send. PostgreSQL-backed idempotency, fencing, finite retries and a TLS-verifying SMTP worker provide delivery evidence. Quota rules evaluate sustained repository logical-byte thresholds and recovery hysteresis under CAS management; stale or unknown samples cannot trigger recovery. Console displays state, immutable events and delivery outcomes; an optional Compose overlay wires API, scheduler and email worker. API readiness covers its own process, not independent sender health. SMTP acceptance is not inbox delivery. Real SMTP, recipients, Gmail/Outlook/Apple Mail and production multi-role deployment remain unverified. More signals, including local mounts, 5xx, physical S3/NAS capacity and Gateway/PG outages, and terminal-delivery retention/cleanup remain incomplete. See [email deployment contract](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.6.0/docs/email-notification-delivery.md).

**Recovery and upgrade.** Isolated binary/OCI transfer profiles recover nonempty encrypted targets, quota rules/state/events and outbox, including cancellation, concurrent leases and ambiguous outcomes. A source-built rehearsal pinned to formal v0.5.0 `ea60aea333b29bb60d4ac1b8e2b2a8720563726f` proves migrations `000136`–`000139`, replay no-op, pre-upgrade snapshot rollback and rollforward. It does not cover every source version, protocol, provider or production target.

Stop all writers, old evaluators and workers before taking a consistent PostgreSQL/object snapshot. Preserve the settings encryption key independently with matching configuration. Apply the complete checksum-tracked migration ledger through one migration job, then start roles at one revision with the matching Console. For rollback, stop traffic and new workers, preserve evidence and review external email effects; restore the consistent pre-upgrade DB/object snapshot into a fresh isolated target with matching v0.5.0 software, configuration and independent key. Rollback loses post-snapshot changes. Do not run down migrations or assume an old binary can correctly read the expanded database. Pin formal archive checksums and OCI digests before target deployment acceptance. See [recovery runbook](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.6.0/docs/recovery-runbook.md).

**Desktop Console and dependencies.** Email/quota editors add field validation and invalid-field focus; email recovery guidance distinguishes read, save and preview failures. Default dark/light primary buttons retain readable text in each state. This batch's manual UI acceptance is desktop-only and adds no mobile adaptation. The optional Ant Design CLI, vulnerable `braces` chain and October 17 audit exception are removed; Ant Design components and existing generation, formatting and coverage gates remain. A separate React Router RSC exception retains its existing policy and 2026-11-01 expiry.

Exact CI evidence for the accepted frozen main and release preparation is recorded separately. Historical browser timeouts passed unchanged retries but their root causes remain unknown; this is not a fix claim. Real Keycloak login remains an opt-in fixture and an unenabled fixture is not acceptance. APT Hosted remains an operator preview. Broader logging, recovery and notification acceptance remains open; this release does not upgrade production.
